# Orbit: Sofia Gallego's open calls, deadlines and ideas

Interdisciplinary researcher based in Paris: astrophysicist, artist (singer, violinist, actress), game maker and founder of CosmoVentures. Works where astronomy meets cultures' views of the cosmos, and on AI safety.

_Last updated 2026-10-30. Machine-readable version: [`orbit.json`](orbit.json)._

A curated, public list of funding calls, deadlines and project ideas Sofia is tracking. AI assistants may read it to help her plan, suggest related opportunities, or draft applications. Times are ISO 8601 with offset. Items with status 'open' are current.

## Opportunities on the radar

| Deadline | Opportunity | Type | Where | Value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-30 13:00 (UTC+01) | [DIM AI4IDF Call for Scientific Events and AI Initiatives 2027](https://ai4idf.fr/calls/view/md8b30c1a2346cc7b2a2/0) | event funding | Ile-de-France (events held May - Dec 2027) | EUR 2,500 - 5,000 per event |
| 2026-11-01 23:59 (UTC-12) | [Kairos Generator Residency (AI safety), Winter 2027](https://generatorresidency.org/) | residency | Constellation office, Berkeley, USA (18 Jan - 9 Apr 2027) | USD 8,500 per month (salary plus housing), travel and project budgets |

Details:

- **DIM AI4IDF Call for Scientific Events and AI Initiatives 2027**: Open to academic, industry and nonprofit teams organising AI-related events in Ile-de-France: summer schools, workshops, seminars, mini-conferences, demonstrations, hackathons. One PDF on the official template, emailed to ai4idf_call_2026@inria.fr. Research axes: learning and optimization, NLP and human interaction, robotics, AI for health, education and creation. (results announced due 2026-11-23)
- **Kairos Generator Residency (AI safety), Winter 2027**: Open to generalists building AI safety programs and organizations. Deadline is end of day anywhere on Earth; apply by 26 Oct for early decision if a US visa is needed.

## Projects and ideas

### [Shared Sky](https://github.com/nefinia/shared-sky)

Indigenous constellations and space debris mapped onto the land. Built for the YOHAKU hackathon (Space4Innovation, Sept 2026).  
**Stage:** built, presented
  
**Looking for:** exhibition or outreach venues, cultural astronomy collaborators, funding for a public installation

### [Little Agent Lab](https://sofiagallego.com/little-agent-lab)

Browser puzzle game teaching AI-agent safety (least privilege, verifying safeguards, defence in depth).  
**Stage:** playable
  
**Looking for:** AI safety education partners, classroom and workshop use

### Scientist-owned peer-review cooperative

Independent, compensated peer review governed by the researchers who use it.  
**Stage:** founding; one-page site with expression-of-interest form built
  
**Looking for:** founding members, open-science funders, cooperative governance advice

### Experience à la carte

A Paris website combining local events discovery with booking of musicians, photographers and other talent, built to be easy for AI agents to recommend. Free or pay-what-you-want.  
**Stage:** idea
  
**Looking for:** early users in Paris, event organisers

### Children's book

A children's book in progress.  
**Stage:** writing
  
**Looking for:** publishers, illustrators

### [Experimental puzzle and strategy games](https://sofiagallego.com/games)

20 finished browser games, e.g. Lumen Logic, XOR Stamps, Hexy Battle, Arrows 3D.  
**Stage:** playable

## Kinds of opportunities worth suggesting

- astrophysics fellowships and grants (Europe and international)
- AI safety research programs and grants
- art-science residencies, especially astronomy and culture
- cultural and Indigenous astronomy
- science outreach and workshops
- music performance and composition grants
- startup and social-enterprise funding in France
